purpose: Return to the original representation/knowledge-association transplantation scope: acquire independently licensed semantically labeled source facts and prove a portable source-to-native intermediary without altering any recipient architecture.
source_kind: Wikidata structured item statements and English entity/property labels, CC0; NOT Qwen feature directions, NOT OpenAI hidden weights/activations, NOT model-generated training examples.
licensing_statement: Wikidata structured data are CC0 per Wikidata:Licensing; record origin and do not copy Wikipedia article text or use unlicensed external prose.
allowed_statement_shape: unqualified nondeprecated mainsnak value wikibase-item only; all other claims excluded, not inferred
label_requirements: English text label of subject, predicate and object must be independently present in same source snapshot, else do not admit record. For missing source item or conflicting first-party raw revision, fail closed.
capture_output: Bounded SHA256-sealed JSON source receipt with source request SHA256, exact statement ids, revisions, QID/PID triples and labels only. May live in CI artifact but not ChatGPT Library. No external texts.
validation_rules: Verify source origin and CC0 provenance
Strict Q/P IDs and exact declared seed universe
Reject novel source IDs/properties and injected JSON fields
Validate typed source-derived Q/P labels and no learned relevance inferred from numeric IDs
Deduplicate identical triples and preserve primary-source claim statement witness
Dry-run no recipient state or weight modification, and abstain on missing associations
Shuffled-label negative and canonical cold snapshot invariance
association_ir: Architecture-independent semantic provenance carrier; can later compile into recipient-native format only under separate owner contracts. Do not program accepted Yggdrasil, Wingless, Hybrid weights.
data_split: No held-out QTR scientific evaluation, no predictive model training; all public fetched facts are source-custody DEV, not evidence of causal understanding.
scientific_pass: IMPOSSIBLE ON F26; source custody and reliable semantic names are necessary, not sufficient
stop_rules: If Wikidata API unavailable/429 or response exceeds frozen bound, record source-custody BLOCKED and do not silently change queries/budget
If no defensible typed Q/P semantic triple exists, NO_GO
If corrupted statement, label, qualifier, ambiguous or deprecated record, exclude or fail closed as specified
No Qwen-to-native coordinate alignment, donor weight claims, or causal inference
next_scientific_protocol: Pin exact admitted source snapshot SHA/rights; freeze concept train/novel relation/negative sets and recipient-specific adapters and conventional exact retrieval, symbolic path, trained KGE/causal baselines, then independent first-use.
authority: Contributor QTR draft source-only engineering; NOT authority for independent recipient integration, scientific first-use or deployment.
